headline: Finance Committee to review $266,174.60 TNC surcharge spending, $400,000 school transfer, and over $2.2 million moved from Roosevelt Park to Malden River Works Project.
summary: The committee will consider appropriating $266,174.60 from the TNC Surcharge Municipal Distribution Account, transferring $400,000 to the Malden Public School Department, and shifting over $2.2 million from the Roosevelt Park Revitalization Project to the Malden River Works Project.
items: Order 391-26: appropriate $266,174.60 from TNC Surcharge Municipal Distribution Account for expenses
Order 392-26: transfer $400,000 from Human Resources Group Insurance Miscellaneous to Malden Public School Department
Order 393-26: repurpose $1,292,045.00 from Roosevelt Park Revitalization Project (Paper 139 Series of 2023) to pay for Malden River Works Project
Order 394-26: transfer $938,174.50 from Roosevelt Park Revitalization Project (Paper 140 Series of 2023) to pay for Malden River Works Project under M.G.L. c. 44, §20
location: City Hall, Room 105, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148
